chip.description: Tilemap generator managing three 64x32 scrolling 8x8-character layers with 16 KB of private RAM, also able to generate timing clocks and NMI/IRQ/FIRQ for the main CPU; paired with the 051962 (taxonomy §4.18 example).
chip.notes: src/mame/konami/k052109.cpp in MAME 0.288. konamiic.txt notes the earlier 051961 is functionally equivalent and interchangeable.
